controls.label: 选择共同片段
controls.inline: async()=>{const kinds=await UI.sheet({title:'片段类型',actions:[{label:'共同日记',value:'diary'},{label:'相册照片',value:'photo'},{label:'重要时刻',value:'moment'}]});if(!kinds)return;const data=await choose(kinds,true);if(data){item.sourceKind=kinds;sourceIds=data.map(v=>v.id);item.sourceIds=[...sourceIds];paintClips();}}

controls.label: 移除片段 共同素材日记
试听演示音轨
controls.inline: async()=>{if(audio){await audio.close();audio=null;play.setAttribute('aria-label','试听演示音轨');return;}try{audio=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const osc=audio.createOscillator(),gain=audio.createGain();osc.frequency.value=[261,329,392,329,293,261][i];gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.04,audio.currentTime+i*.4);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,audio.currentTime+i*.4+.35);osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(audio.destination);osc.start(audio.currentTime+i*.4);osc.stop(audio.currentTime+i*.4+.36);}play.setAttribute('aria-label','停止试听');setTimeout(async()=>{if(audio){await audio.close();audio=null;}play.setAttribute('aria-label','试听演示音轨');},2500);}catch{UI.toast('音轨暂时无法播放，请重试','error');}}

controls.label: 取消生成
controls.inline: async()=>{deciding=true;const confirmed=await UI.modal({title:'取消这次生成？',message:'输入会保留为草稿。',confirm:'保留草稿并取消',cancel:'继续生成'});if(!confirmed){deciding=false;return;}if(W.put({...item,status:'draft',updatedAt:Date.now()}))return UI.go(W.editor(item),{force:true});}

controls.label: 给另一半看看
controls.inline: async()=>{const link=make('input');link.value=location.href;link.readOnly=true;link.setAttribute('aria-label','当前原型作品链接');const result=await UI.sheet({title:'给另一半看看',message:'此链接仅在同一台设备的本地原型数据中可查看。',content:link,actions:[{label:'复制作品链接',value:'copy'}]});if(result==='copy'){try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link.value);UI.toast('作品链接已复制','success');}catch{UI.modal({title:'复制作品链接',message:'请选中下方链接并复制。',content:link,confirm:'关闭'});link.select();}}}

漫画 · 生成失败
刷新我的创作
controls.inline: async function load(){if(loading)return;loading=true;refresh.disabled=true;list.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');list.replaceChildren(UI.components.loading({mode:'skeleton',label:'正在翻开创作集…'}));await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,400));loading=false;refresh.disabled=false;list.removeAttribute('aria-busy');if(UI.failNext('work-load')){list.replaceChildren();list.append(UI.components.state({kind:'error',title:'创作集暂时打不开',action:'重试加载创作',onAction:load}));}else paint();}

controls.label: 更新我们的主角
controls.inline: ()=>UI.busy(document.querySelector('#save'),'保存设定…',()=>{const empty=inputs.find(v=>!v.value.trim());if(empty){UI.fieldError(empty,'请填写这项主角设定');empty.focus();return false;}if(UI.failNext('work-characters'))throw new Error('主角设定未保存，请重试');if(!UI.write('dujia-characters',Object.fromEntries(inputs.map(v=>[v.id,v.value.trim()]))))return false;leave.commit();if(work)return UI.go(W.editor(work),{force:true});UI.toast('主角设定已更新','success');return true;})
